description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order to amend the Schedule of the Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 1454/37 of 22.07.2006 which specifies the Faculties & the Departments of the University of Kelaniya
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to university regulations under the Universities Act. It contains an order issued by the Minister exercising powers under Section 27(1) of the Universities Act to amend the schedule specifying faculties and departments of the University of Kelaniya. While it mentions a minister by name, this is incidental to the core legal/regulatory function of amending statutory instruments under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
